back: Z = protons (atomic number). A = protons + neutrons (mass number).
By gaining (anion) or losing (cation) electrons — protons never change.
Same Z, different numbers of neutrons. Same chemistry, slightly different physical properties.
Weighted mean mass of an atom relative to 1/12 of ¹²C: Σ(mass × abundance)/Σabundance.
Peak position = m/z (isotope mass); peak height = relative abundance.
